senses.gloss:
(I)--married शान्ति, a daughter of Kardama. It was he who spread यज्ञ in the world.
1: भा. III. २४. २४.
His son was दध्यञ्च who had a horse's head.
2: Ib. IV. 1. ४२.
[page१-043+ २९]
(II)--a ब्राह्मन् priest invited by युधिष्- ठिर to officiate in his राजसूय sacrifice. भा. X. ७४. 9.

--one of the four Vedas useful for kings.
1: भा., X. ५३. १२; वा. 9. ५१; ६०. १५, २०.
Rearranged by Sumantu (s.v.) under the guidance of व्यास; in five parts.
2: भा. I. 4. २२; XII. 7. 1; Br. II. ३४. १५; Vi. III. 4. 9 & १४; 6. 8, १३-14.
Part of विष्णु.
3: Vi. V. 1. ३७.
मन्त्रस् connected with war.
4: Br. IV. २०. १०४.
Twenty-one Atharvas from the face of ब्रह्मा.
5: Br. II. 8. ५३.

--name of the Veda personified, as the son of प्रजापति An3giras and Sati:
1: भा. VI. 6. १९; वा. ६५. ९८.
Praise of Soma.
2: Br. III. ६५. १२.
To be uttered in founding a temple.
3: M. २६५. २८.
--taught by व्यास to Sumantu. भा. XII. 6. ५३.
--a लौकिकाग्नि; is भृगु; father of दर्पहा. Belongs to दध्यङ्गाथर्वण category. वा. २९. 8, 9; Br. II. १२, 9.
--५०००+980 according to ऋषिस् like अङ्गीरस. वा. ६१. ७२.
